Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TSLA.
Operating income reached $4.1 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.77 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 132 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 132 basis points to 66.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 132 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
